reviewAdvisory: The figure records label the 645 and 625 yuan per tonne cuts as 'retail price' changes, but the body and blockquote correctly describe them as changes to the ex-refinery ceiling (标准品), so the record's unit misstates what the notice sets and contradicts the article's own definition.
Two of the six figure records carry dates ('11月12日24时', '10月29日') as values with a 'unit' of effective time or date, which is not a figure with a value and unit and inflates the sourced-figure count.
The declared information_gain is 'custom-calculation', which is not one of the permitted values (primary, cross-source, analysis).
The title ends mid-word ('yuan a'), so the headline is broken and does not state the unit or the effective date.

The single-source disclosure appears only inside the confidence section; the body presents the 12315 enforcement line and the ten-working-day mechanism as settled without a reader-facing note that one document is the whole basis.
